info.cls_ename: RMIT-FCU 2+2 Bachelor's Program in Business and Innovation

description.describe_ch: 了解創新的本質、類型、挑戰與重要性，以及如何能規劃創新成為企業策略驅動主力，並有效執行。探討創新於企業內之落實與外部環境之影響因子，以進一步引導學生進行創新專案之規劃、設計與評估。並且透過問題意識的建立與專案規劃與評估技巧，引導學生將組織內不同形式之創新，例如「技術創新、產品創新、策略創新、流程創新、服務創新與管理創新」，融入企業經營的策略與產業發展脈絡。
description.describe_eh: This course addresses selected challenges and opportunities related to managing innovation. We will move from an overview of the role of different types of innovation to the managerial strategies and tactics for fostering innovation in organizations and industries. The class takes a pragmatic approach to learning; students will be innovating as a class assignment so that they will encounter problems that will spur them to actively search for solutions. Course content includes readings, case analyses, written assignments, in-class videos, exercises, and discussion. The goal is to provide theories that help students critically evaluate the many misconceptions about innovation, and to provide practical help for managing innovation now and in the future.

gradeRuleDescribe.tpa_score_new_en:
Final Score is comprised of the following three elements:
  1. 30% Weekly attendance and participation
  2. 40% Weekly assignments
  3. 30% Midterm and final presentation + report
 
1. Weekly attendance and participation (30%)
  • Attendance logging: Students are expected to log and register their attendance via the FCU attendance system.  Along with random manual attendance taking, this element will account for 15% of final score.
  • In-class discussion: Each week, there will in-class discussions.  I will mark a positive point if  you are present and discuss the topic. I will mark a negative point if you are not present or not able to discuss the topic
2. Weekly assignments (40%)
  • Students are expected to complete and submit their weekly assignments on time via iLearn.
    10% penalty for each week late up to
    1) midterm scoring after week 8 [cut-off for first half of the semester]  and,
    2) final scoring after week 17 [cut-off for second half of the semester]
 
3. Midterm and final presentation + report (30%)
  • Midterm and final presentation plus report accounts for 15% of final grade each. The presentation will either be delivered in-person or through record video.
  • Midterm presentation and report will be individual-based
  • Final presenation and report will be team-based
  • Students are expected to follow the midterm presentation instructions and submit their midterm report on time on iLearn.
    Grading will be based on
    1) following instructions
    2) completion
    3) timeliness
    4) quality

gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno_en:
Students are expected to particiate, do their own work, and complete their assignments, presentation and reports at the expected college level.
 
Presentation and reports that contain statements that appear to be a copy-paste of information from the Internet or an AI system will be questioned and penalized.
 
It is OK for students to utilize the wealth of information from the Internet or generative AI systems. However, students are expected to summarize in their own words.
 
One evaluative method that I will use is:  "Use your own words.  Don't use a statement or word if you can't speak it with some basic fluency."
